observations.locator: Printed pp.2,12: Intended use and joint sawing
observations.paraphrase: Professional outdoor early-entry use; layout approval and concrete supporting saw/operator precede cutting.

observations.locator: Printed pp.12,14: System criteria and To do work with dust
observations.paraphrase: Blade/skid pairing and extraction connection are specified; an adapter may be needed and extraction performance can change.
Blade removal, vehicle restraint and designated lifting arrangements are prescribed.

observations.locator: Printed p.16: To clean the product externally
observations.paraphrase: Immediate cleaning includes blade removal and brush/water cleaning of the blade block before residues harden.

observations.locator: PDF pp.4–5: Louisiana study and Summary
observations.paraphrase: Setting conditions affect practice; a pavement study changed cut depth; guidance discusses surface support and skid condition.
conditions: fresh pavement; transfer limit to floors

observations.locator: PDF p.2: item c and rules 1–3
observations.paraphrase: Plan joint location and sawing timing before construction; early-entry timing depends on concrete setting characteristics.

observations.locator: PDF p.2: Transport and storage; Change skid plate; Check blade block plungers
observations.paraphrase: Advises blade/skid checks, blade removal for transport and daily blade-block cleaning.
Contractor offers fresh-concrete joint cutting and emphasizes timing and precision.

observations.locator: How We Perform… steps 2–3; cleanup line; early-entry FAQ
observations.paraphrase: Describes cut-line marking, specified depth and cleanup; offers early-entry work with differing timing wording.

observations.locator: Where Dust Becomes a Problem; vacuum-selection FAQ
observations.paraphrase: Identifies dust around operators/equipment; system selection depends on airflow, hose length and site conditions.

observations.locator: PDF p.1: introduction and Wet Cutting
observations.paraphrase: Cutting silica-containing materials creates respirable dust; described control is continuous water delivery.

observations.locator: Printed pp.10–14: tool replacement, extractor connection and stopping
observations.paraphrase: Tool change involves tilting and tool plates; hose/filter checks precede extraction; stop guidance mentions adhesive/paint surfaces.

observations.locator: Printed pp.24,28–29: preparation, operation and transport
observations.paraphrase: Describes stump preparation, chip clearance, below-grade handling adjustment and two-person lifting when necessary.

opportunities.title: Readiness and handoff support
opportunities.hypothesis: Contextual job card for specifications, handoff, conditions and operator observations.
opportunities.validation: Interview two operators and a foreman about the last job; test the card on one supervised pour; record missing inputs, overrides and decision agreement. No predicted safe start time.

opportunities.title: Consumable-condition and setup support
opportunities.hypothesis: Improve blade/skid inspection cues and evaluate a maintainable interface.
opportunities.validation: Observe qualified operators using current checks and a mockup; record omissions/usability; controlled approved cuts can compare edge condition.

opportunities.title: Extraction compatibility and condition support
opportunities.hypothesis: Fit/condition checklist, then investigate coupling or airflow indication.
opportunities.validation: With a competent safety specialist inspect two setups, document fit/hose/filter issues, and compare proposed indications with instrumented measurements.

opportunities.title: Cleaning and next-job readiness
opportunities.hypothesis: Evaluate easier blade-block access and a service completion cue.
opportunities.validation: Observe cleaning on two jobs with consent; record tasks/residue/access; test a nonfunctional access mockup.

opportunities.title: Transport kit and reassembly support
opportunities.hypothesis: Protected blade/skid storage and kit-readiness checklist.
opportunities.validation: Observe one depot-to-site transfer, count handling steps, ask about access and compare packaging mockup.
